offence_note: Conspiracy to export and produce methamphetamine; firearms and prohibition breaches
sentence_quote: I conclude in all of the circumstances that the judge made no error and the 15-year global sentence was fit. I would therefore grant leave, but dismiss the appeal.

sentence_quote: I sentence you to a term of imprisonment for 18 months, which term shall be served in the community as a conditional sentence
note: 12 months house arrest then 6 months curfew.

offence_note: Breach of trust by police officer
sentence_quote: The trial judge imposed an 18-month conditional sentence.

offence_note: Aggravated assault, common assault, weapon dangerous to public
sentence_quote: The appellant was sentenced to two years less a day followed by two years probation; a ten-year prohibition order pursuant to s. 109 was made, as well.

offence_note: Robbery, theft, two breaches of probation
